childish.linePrev: And the nights when the living room was on the lawn

stanza: I remember when the days were long
And the nights when the living room was on the lawn
Constant quarreling, the childish fits
And our clothes in a pile on the ottoman

childish.line: When I was five or six we were camping in the islands in July, the tall yellow…

stanza: All my life I can remember longing
Looking across the water and seeing lights
When I was five or six we were camping in the islands in July, the tall yellow…
And then when I was twenty-four I followed this ache to an arctic Norwegian cab…

childish.linePrev: You were turning 'round to see who was behind you
childish.line: And I took your childish laughter by surprise
childish.lineNext: And at the moment that my camera happened to find you
stanza: Looking through some photographs I found inside a drawer
I was taken by a photograph of you
There were one or two I know that you
Would have liked a little more
But they didn't show your spirit quite as true
You were turning 'round to see who was behind you
And I took your childish laughter by surprise
And at the moment that my camera happened to find you
There was just a trace of sorrow in your eyes

childish.linePrev: Let the poets pipe of love
childish.lineNext: I know every type of love
stanza: Let the poets pipe of love
In their childish way
I know every type of love
Better far than they

childish.linePrev: That I myself was among the ones who thought
childish.line: It was just a childish thing to do
childish.lineNext: Tears of rage, tears of grief
stanza: We pointed you the way to go
And scratched your name in sand
Though you just thought it was nothing more
Than a place for you to stand
I want you to know that while we watched
You discovered no one would be true
That I myself was among the ones who thought
It was just a childish thing to do

childish.linePrev: So you wished for a kiss from God
childish.line: And you mourned in your childish loss
childish.lineNext: Innocence gone but it's not forgot
stanza: Though they may take you for all you had left
You won't be forgotten for what you had not done yet
So you wished for a kiss from God
And you mourned in your childish loss
Innocence gone but it's not forgot
You'll get your way through it somehow

childish.linePrev: You could hear the ocean in a seashell
stanza: And I used to think
You could hear the ocean in a seashell
What a childish thing

childish.lineNext: Laid a kiss on your head
stanza: I forgave you your shortcomings
And ignored your childish behaviour
Laid a kiss on your head
And before I left said, "Stay away from fleeting favour"

childish.lineNext: But I love to be young
stanza: He chased me through the rain
"Honey, I'm going your way'"
I don't think so
You can chase me through the rain
And scream my name, a childish game
But I love to be young
And honey, I was never gonna change
And honey, you are never gonna change
But you love, don't you love it that way?
